requirement: Describe REDUCE as a prospective, randomized, multinational, multicenter, open-label device trial comparing PFO closure plus antiplatelet therapy with antiplatelet therapy alone.

evidence.text: The study summary describes the two-arm prospective randomized multinational multicenter device trial.

requirement: Specify 2:1 allocation in favor of the closure/device arm and state that randomization is not stratified by site or other baseline variables.

evidence.text: Randomization is weighted 2:1 to test and is not stratified.

requirement: Report planned enrollment of approximately 664 participants at up to 80 sites, with 2:1 allocation and follow-up through 60 months.

evidence.text: Approximately 664 subjects at up to 80 sites are randomized 2:1 and followed for 60 months.

requirement: Define co-primary endpoint 1 as time from randomization to first recurrent ischemic stroke or imaging-confirmed TIA through at least 24 months, censoring event-free participants at last known contact.
acceptable_values: time to first recurrent ischemic stroke or imaging-confirmed TIA

evidence.text: The first co-primary endpoint is time to first recurrent event with last-contact censoring.

requirement: Use the source event definitions: ischemic stroke is a presumed ischemic neurological deficit lasting over 24 hours or until death; TIA lasts under 24 hours and requires MRI evidence of a new relevant infarct.

evidence.text: The SAP operationalizes the duration and imaging criteria for stroke and TIA.

requirement: Define co-primary endpoint 2 as the subject-level incidence of a new brain infarct or ischemic stroke from screening through 24 months or the last earlier follow-up, with a new T2 lesion of at least 3 mm qualifying as MRI response.

evidence.text: The second co-primary endpoint is a binomial subject response based on new infarct/stroke through 24 months.

requirement: Use all randomized participants analyzed as assigned as the primary ITT set for both co-primary endpoints.

evidence.text: The ITT set is all randomized subjects analyzed by assigned treatment and is primary.

requirement: Define supportive per-protocol and as-treated sets, distinguishing protocol-concordant treatment from any PFO closure actually received.
acceptable_values: as-treated by any PFO closure received

evidence.text: The SAP separately defines per-protocol and as-treated analysis sets.

requirement: Analyze co-primary endpoint 1 with an unadjusted log-rank test and Kaplan-Meier estimates, including available follow-up through 5 years.

evidence.text: Freedom from recurrent event uses unadjusted log-rank and Kaplan-Meier with follow-up through five years.

requirement: Analyze co-primary endpoint 2 with a two-sample binomial-proportions comparison among evaluable participants and report the test-control difference with an unadjusted two-sided 95% confidence interval.

evidence.text: Brain infarct is compared as a two-sample binomial proportion with a 95% CI for the difference.

requirement: Control multiplicity for the simultaneous one-sided co-primary tests at overall alpha 0.025 using adjusted p-values informed by endpoint correlation; both endpoint decisions must use the adjusted threshold.

evidence.text: Both co-primary hypotheses are tested simultaneously with multiplicity-adjusted p-values against one-sided 0.025.

requirement: Include worst-case, best-case, and if needed tipping-point sensitivity analyses for withdrawal or loss to follow-up on both co-primary endpoints.

evidence.text: The SAP specifies worst-case, best-case, and possible tipping-point analyses.

requirement: Assess site poolability using treatment, site, and treatment-by-site interaction in Cox regression for recurrence and logistic regression for brain infarct; combine sites with fewer than five participants by US versus non-US region.
acceptable_values: sites under five pooled by US/non-US

evidence.text: Site heterogeneity is assessed with endpoint-appropriate interaction models and small sites are pooled by region.

requirement: Record that independent core-laboratory readers assessing MRI/CT images are blinded to randomized treatment and that suspected endpoint events are adjudicated by an independent CEC.

evidence.text: The independent CEC adjudicates events and imaging core-lab readers are treatment-blinded.

requirement: Summarize subject incidence of AEs by MedDRA SOC/PT, seriousness, relationship to device/procedure/antiplatelet therapy, and onset timing, with appropriate evaluable denominators.

evidence.text: AE rates are subject-based proportions grouped by coding, seriousness, relationship, and timing.

requirement: Evaluate comparability of HELEX and CARDIOFORM device subgroups with prespecified baseline and outcome interaction models at alpha 0.15, clearly labeling these numerous tests as unadjusted exploratory poolability analyses.

evidence.text: Device poolability uses multiple alpha-0.15 tests without multiplicity correction.

requirement: State that the originally planned formal interim analysis was rescinded and that no interim analysis with formal hypothesis testing is planned.

evidence.text: The original event-based interim was rescinded; no formal interim hypothesis tests remain.
